ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is here to ensure Premium field is never blank Mini Fleet Queries record type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
RecordType.DeveloperName = "Mini_Fleet_Queries",
ISBLANK(Premium_Quoted__c),
OR(
ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed Declined Quote'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Unable to Cover'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Quoted NTU'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Uncompetitive'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Sold')
)
)
